items.difficulty_reason: 7 行、glueing 对的 Tor_1 零化：0 -> R[f^n] -> R -> f^nR -> 0 的 Tor 长正合列把 Tor_1(R', f^nR) 化为 R[f^n]⊗R' -> R' 的核；torsion-completion 引理给 R[f^n]⊗R' = R[f^n]，same-f-torsion 引理给 R[f^n] -> R' 单射（glueing 对定义），故 Tor 为零。承重全在 span 内；2 处引用作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-first-tor (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 25471-25475

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the long exact Tor sequence of the presentation of f^n R as a quotient, the reduction to the injectivity of R[f^n] tensor R' -> R', and the identification of that tensor product with the f^n-torsion submodule together with its injectivity into R' from the glueing pair axioms (source lines 25477-25483)
